text: Theo re-runs the same cluster metrics the FinOps dashboard already reads, but splits them by availability zone instead of blending them into one number.
The pod listing tells the story immediately: eight of checkout-api's twelve pods are running in a single zone, eastus2-2. The other two zones have only two pods each.

The real per-zone CPU numbers: eastus2-2's eight pods are running at roughly ninety-six percent, nearly saturated, while the other two zones sit at about twenty-four percent. Blended together, that's exactly the healthy-looking seventy-two percent average.

The scheduler isn't broken — it packed pods efficiently with no instruction to spread them. checkout-api's Deployment, built back in Lesson 4, never got a topology spread constraint. Next lesson, Theo fixes it live.
